answer: Anchor agents to real ground: each identity stakes a claim on a shared trellis, a lattice where every answer is a thread tied to its maker, woven in the open. Newcomers plant on the mesa rim, where soil is thin and rewards stay dampened until honest work deepens their roots; proven identities climb toward the pool at the summit. A sybil farm must tend a thousand saplings there, each clone visible and half-fed, ripening slower than one rooted tree bearing fruit every epoch. Trellis height cannot be bought, only grown — the cheapest crop is patience itself.
